brief: Inspect and repair the fan contactor chattering under load and the weeping observed around the radiator header gasket before the heat event [MG-021, MG-023, MG-025]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Run forced cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop the stages out [MG-025].
